clue.text: Riddler endlessly chattering, loathing lost muscle

indicators.note: endlessly says the Riddler's word loses its final letter

parts.note: the Sphinx of Greek myth set the famous riddle to travellers

indicators.note: lost says the letters of the loathing word go missing from chattering

parts.note: loathing is hating

explanation.surface: A gossiping riddler who has stopped hating people loses a muscle.
explanation.walkthrough: SPHIN is SPHINX minus its end; CHATTERING with H,A,T,I,N,G taken out in order leaves CTER.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphincter is a ring-shaped muscle that closes a bodily opening.

clue.text: Dry sweat with Italian lady in a hot place?

indicators.note: dry here means with the wet removed, so the letters of wet leave sweat

parts.note: una is the feminine form of the Italian indefinite article, so a feminine one, a lady

explanation.surface: Someone dries off sweat with an Italian woman in a warm spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking W,E,T out of SWEAT leaves SA; the question mark admits the definition is a loose description.
explanation.definitionFit: A sauna is a heated room or cabin where people sit to sweat.

clue.text: Where the sky begins, the earth ends at last in formation of stars

indicators.note: ends points to the final letter of the word earth
in puts the letter for last inside the constellation

parts.note: Orion is a well-known constellation, a pattern of stars
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A description of where sky meets ground, ending in the stars.
explanation.definitionFit: The horizon is the line where the sky appears to meet the land or sea.

clue.text: An awful thing, the moment when stars appear

indicators.note: awful suggests the word thing is mangled into a new order

parts.note: the moment is a time, as in 'at this time'

explanation.surface: A nightmare described as an awful thing arriving at dusk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'An' is a link; rearranging THING gives NIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Night-time is the period of darkness, when stars become visible.

clue.text: A lot to arrange, not all reported

parts.note: to tidy is to arrange neatly

indicators.note: reported signals that the next word is heard rather than read

parts.note: some means not all of a group

explanation.surface: Someone with a great deal to sort out, only part of it told.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidy sum is an idiom for a considerable amount of money.

clue.text: American rearranged thatching stuff to include pattern

indicators.note: to include says the thatch material holds the pattern word inside

parts.note: reed is used for thatching roofs
a model is a pattern to copy

explanation.surface: An American reorganised the reed for a thatched roof around a design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'American' marks the US spelling with one L.
explanation.definitionFit: To remodel is to reshape or restructure; the single L is American spelling.

clue.text: See 3
Support for afternoon service (latter-day version omitting original characters)

indicators.note: a version of the phrase is a new arrangement of its letters
the starting letters of latter and day are dropped

explanation.surface: A modern take on a tea set, with the old pieces left out.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping L and D from LATTERDAY leaves ATTERAY, which is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea tray carries the cups and pot when afternoon tea is served.

clue.text: Preserve holy one appointed by Spooner

indicators.note: Spooner's name signals swapping the opening sounds of two words

parts.note: a lama is a Buddhist holy man
made, as in made captain, means appointed

explanation.surface: A holy man given office by the famously muddled Oxford don.
explanation.walkthrough: LAMA MADE becomes MAMA LADE, which in a non-rhotic British accent sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Marmalade is a fruit preserve, usually made from oranges.

clue.text: Moved in anger to expose newspaper boss

parts.note: to out someone is to expose them
rag is slang for a poor newspaper
ED is short for editor, the boss of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A furious campaign to unmask a newspaper's editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Outraged means provoked to strong anger or indignation.

clue.text: Inadequate theme: a Great Bear appears

indicators.note: the words bear the answer, which appears within them

explanation.surface: A themed puzzle with the Great Bear constellation turning up, found lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: The setter has said Great Bear is just part of the surface; the run is themE A GREat.
explanation.definitionFit: Meagre means scanty or insufficient in amount.

clue.text: Wacky Tom and Taz are crackers

indicators.note: wacky says the names are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Two cartoon characters, Tom and Taz, are a bit mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crackers' looks like 'mad'; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Matzot are the flat unleavened breads, like crackers, eaten at Passover.

clue.text: Players as Madrid's, named as stars

parts.note: a side is a team of players
Real is the first word of the football club Real Madrid

explanation.surface: Footballers like Real Madrid's, all famous names.
explanation.definitionFit: Sidereal means relating to or measured by the stars.

clue.text: Investigator misses nothing in a crook

indicators.note: misses says a letter is left out of the investigator

parts.note: a coroner investigates sudden deaths
O is the round figure zero

explanation.surface: A detective who comes up empty against a criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: A crook is a bend or angle, as in the crook of an arm.

clue.text: Cracks in new order or else in new start

indicators.note: putting the words in new order means rearranging their letters
start picks the opening letter of the second new

explanation.surface: Fissures appear in a reorganisation or else in a fresh beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Cracks are quips, and a one-liner is a joke in a single sentence.

clue.text: Sunday lunch of wild boar, holding whisky glass — bottoms up!

indicators.note: holding says the rearranged animal goes round the drink
wild suggests the word boar is scrambled
bottoms up, the drinker's toast, tips the drink word over so it reads from the end

parts.note: malts are glasses of malt whisky; the blogger thought the plural loose

explanation.surface: A hearty roast of wild boar with a whisky toast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottoms up' is the drinker's toast, turning the whisky glasses over; 'wild' scrambles the animal, which then holds them.
explanation.definitionFit: Roast lamb is a typical dish of the British Sunday lunch, a weekly family meal.

clue.text: Boatman's type taken in on method of formation of stars

indicators.note: on means placed next to, so the method word follows
taken in says the type word goes inside the setter's possessive

parts.note: Boatman is the setter, so the setter's is MY
ilk is a type or kind
a way is a method

explanation.surface: The setter's sort of person admitted on the strength of how he works.
explanation.definitionFit: The Milky Way is our galaxy, a vast system of stars.

clue.text: Decaying star in dock after recorded statement

indicators.note: statement signals that the words are spoken, not spelt

parts.note: a wharf is a dock, placed after read, which for a meter means recorded (a stretch, said the blogger)

explanation.surface: A dying star appears in court after a taped confession is played.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In dock' suggests a courtroom; dock is a ship's berth.
explanation.definitionFit: A red dwarf is a small, cool, dim star.

clue.text: Batman and Joker turning up for kids in Hollywood?

indicators.note: in a down answer turning up means reading the word from the bottom

parts.note: a card is a joker, an amusing person
U is the British film certificate for universal viewing, suitable for children
Hollywood is in LA, Los Angeles

explanation.surface: Comic book hero and villain feature in children's films from Hollywood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Batman' looks like the superhero; it is a man who turns into a bat.
explanation.definitionFit: Dracula, the vampire, can transform into a bat, so he is a bat-man.

clue.text: Piece of branch with shoot on it

indicators.note: in a down answer, on it puts the shoot word above the branch word

parts.note: fire means shoot a gun
an arm is a branch, as of a tree or organisation

explanation.surface: A section of a tree branch with a new shoot growing.
explanation.definitionFit: Piece is slang for a gun, a firearm.

clue.text: Criminal bribed with earth-moving kit

indicators.note: criminal suggests the letters of bribed are crooked, rearranged

explanation.surface: A crook pays off officials with heavy plant machinery.
explanation.definitionFit: A dibber is a pointed hand tool for making holes in soil.

clue.text: Aging, decaying, taking two seconds for the formation of stars

indicators.note: decaying suggests the letters fall apart and reform
two says the seconds letter appears twice

parts.note: B denotes second class, second best

explanation.surface: Something ageing and rotting picks up a couple of extra moments.
explanation.definitionFit: The Big Bang is the event thought to have begun the universe, before any stars formed.

clue.text: An awful thing: see a formation of stars die

indicators.note: formation of means the letters of the words are formed afresh

explanation.surface: Watch as a constellation dies away.
explanation.definitionFit: A disaster is a calamity; 'dis-aster' literally means ill-starred.

clue.text: Leader to come back, able to move the spirit

indicators.note: the leader of come is its first letter
back sends the phrase for able to move reading backwards

parts.note: in a board game, if you can go you are able to move

explanation.surface: A leader returns, fit enough to rouse the people's mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Cognac is a French brandy, a spirit.

clue.text: Origin of creation heralds appearance of stars

definitions.text: Origin of creation heralds appearance of stars

indicators.note: origin means the beginning, so the starting letter of each word is taken

explanation.surface: The beginning of the universe announces the stars coming out.
explanation.walkthrough: The initial letters of the last five words spell it; read whole, the clue describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Chaos was the void from which creation came, before the stars.

clue.text: An arrangement of stars wrongly set as &Lit

indicators.note: wrongly set means the letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: the ampersand is crossword shorthand; its word part reads lit

explanation.surface: A self-referential clue type misapplied to a celebrity line-up.
explanation.definitionFit: The A-list is the top tier of celebrities, a ranking of stars.

clue.text: Unable to arrange formation of stars

indicators.note: to arrange means the letters of unable are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone cannot organise a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: A nebula is a cloud of gas and dust where stars form.

clue.text: Boatman unmoved after article regarding military invasion

indicators.note: after says the sailor and unchanged words come behind the article

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
as is means unchanged, unmoved

explanation.surface: The setter, unmoved, comments on a piece about an armed incursion.
explanation.walkthrough: Boatman is also the setter's name, but here it means a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: The Anabasis is Xenophon's account of a military expedition upcountry; the word means an advance inland.

clue.text: The East is held back by America's extremes?

indicators.note: held says the reversed word sits inside the letters from America
extremes are the first and last letters of America
back means is reads the wrong way round

explanation.surface: Eastern power is restrained by the far ends of the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: Asia is the continent of the Orient, the East.

clue.text: Volatile big shot takes medic on board aerial war contraption

indicators.note: on board means inside, so the medic letters go within
volatile means unstable, so the letters of big shot are scrambled

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: An erratic VIP brings a doctor aboard a warplane.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombsight is the device in a bomber aircraft for aiming bombs.
